entry.title: Poli-q 1.1.2
entry.summary: 8-band dynamic EQ: bells, shelves, cuts 6-48 dB/oct, notch, band pass, tilt; live curve, visualizer, Learn (fits the preset to your voice), 43 presets **For:** second-generation MPCs (MPC Live III, One G2, Key G2, XL) on MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. **Tested on:** MPC Live III, MPC OS 3.10.1. **Install:** from the Open MPC catalog or the Plugin Manager, or by hand: unzip, copy the folder inside `portable/` into `VST2 Plugins` at the root of a drive, turn on Preferences > Enhancements > External Plugi
